text:
anya (ML): quick summary from the halcyon11-lite bring-up experiments — posting the short econ/quality notes here so GTN/product can react
liam (Product): thanks, brief please — product wants a traffic rec and whether we can ship int6 or need int8 fallback
sam (Eval): ran the 1k-slice longform summarization and QA suite this morning. highlights: int6 reduces cost ~2.7x vs fp16, int8 ~1.7x. latency p50 ints: int6=160ms, int8=200ms at our 4096 kvcache setup. p95 tails: int6=420ms, int8=510ms
maya (GTN): how are the quality numbers vs our baseline (nova10b-int6 currently in prod)? we care summary ROUGE-L and answer-level F1
anya (ML): baseline nova10b-int6 on the same slices: ROUGE-L=42.8, answer F1=78.5. halcyon11-lite fp16 = 44.1 / 80.2. halcyon11-lite int8 = 43.5 / 79.6. halcyon11-lite int6 = 41.9 / 77.0 (noticeable drop on longer context prompts)
frank (SWE): can you share unit econ numbers? cost per 1M tokens or per 10k requests?
anya (ML): rough numbers from our infra pricing: fp16 cost ~= $0.95 per 1M tokens, int8 ~= $0.56 per 1M, int6 ~= $0.35 per 1M. So int6 saves ~63% vs fp16. But quality drop at long context is ~4% ROUGE-L and ~3.2 F1 absolute on our critical slices.
sam (Eval): small qual breakdown: short-answer QA unaffected (<0.5% drop). multi-paragraph summarization, chain-of-reasoning QA, and code generation all show biggest regressions for int6. single-turn chat is fine.
liam (Product): product signal: longform summaries and multi-step reasoning are priority in our docs feature. We can't take >2% F1 drop. So int6 looks risky for full traffic
maya (GTN): GTN recommendation: use int8 as primary for this model and route heavy longform slices to nova10b-int6 for now? But that means routing cost and complexity
frank (SWE): routing policy option sketch: canary halcyon11-lite-int8 at 5% traffic, shadow int6 for perf/monitoring only. traffic-split JSON (draft):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"selector": "shortform-*", "model": "halcyon11-lite-int8", "weight": 0.85},
    {"selector": "longform-*", "model": "nova10b-int6", "weight": 0.10},
    {"selector": "fallback-any", "model": "halcyon11-lite-int6", "weight": 0.05}
  ],
  "canary": {"halcyon11-lite-int8": 0.05}
}
```
anya (ML): ops notes: int6 KV cache behavior seems fine, but attention kernel occasionally causes p95 spikes on >8k context slices. we flagged an optimization ticket. If we expect many long-context requests, int6's tail risk could hit SLOs
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for halcyon11-lite-int8 at 05:12 UTC — monitoring enabled
maya (GTN): product ask: what's your recommended default rollout percentage and guardrails?
anya (ML): recommended: start canary 5% for 24h, monitor the eval harness and production slices for 12h. If ROUGE/F1 deltas <0.5% and p95 latency within +15%, bump to 25% for 48h. Keep int6 as a cold fallback but do not route production longform to int6 until kernel fixes + a follow-up 1k-slice int6 qual recheck
frank (SWE): I'll add an automated regression watch: if any of these trigger (ROUGE-L drop >1.5, answer-F1 drop>1.0, p95 increase >25%) then rollback to nova10b-int6 and notify #eng-oncall
sam (Eval): for GTN: quick scorecard snapshot you can paste into briefing:

- model: halcyon11-lite
- variants: fp16 / int8 / int6
- shortform ROUGE-L: fp16=44.1, int8=43.5, int6=41.9
- answer-F1: fp16=80.2, int8=79.6, int6=77.0
- cost per 1M tokens: fp16=$0.95, int8=$0.56, int6=$0.35
- latency p50/p95 (4096 ctx): fp16=150/380ms, int8=200/510ms, int6=160/420ms
- recommended default: halcyon11-lite-int8 (canary 5% -> 25%); route longform to nova10b-int6 until int6 tail fix

maya (GTN): perfect, thanks. can you also include a short blurb the sales/AE team can use re: cost savings vs FP16?
anya (ML): blurb for sales: "Halcyon11-lite int8 preserves >99% of shortform quality while cutting per-token inference cost by ~40% vs fp16. For long multi-paragraph tasks we recommend hybrid routing to our existing nova10b-int6 to protect quality while capturing most of the econ benefit."
liam (Product): action items: frank to set up the watchdog + routing config, anya to file perf kernel ticket and rerun int6 1k-slice after fix, sam to publish the scorecard doc and add the eval slices to the monitoring dashboard, maya to brief GTN/sales this afternoon
frank (SWE): taking the routing/watchdog items now :eyes:
anya (ML): I'll post the full eval matrices and the sample prompts in the docs channel once kernel ticket is filed
maya (GTN): thanks all. will share recommendation with sales and schedule a 30m sync if any follow-ups from PMs
liam (Product): tl;dr — ship int8 as primary, keep int6 offline until tail issues are resolved, policy-based hybrid routing for longform. :thumbsup:
